role: City Engineer of the City of Milwaukee
stance_basis: authorized spokesman stating proposed connection is needed and in the public interest
summary: H. McCullough, City Engineer of the City of Milwaukee, testified at the March 25, 1969 Corridor Location Public Hearing as the authorized spokesman for the Milwaukee Common Council. He stated that the interested departments within the City of Milwaukee had reviewed the maps and preliminary sketches and agreed that the proposed Airport Spur connection is needed and is in the public interest. No response from the Division of Highways was deemed necessary.
